data.body: Fresh occurrence datum (2026-08-22, session closing lead-unpleasing-kitten): after a description edit staled the prior attestation, a fresh review-plan PASSed but sign_manifest failed with 'remained unstable after 3 attempts' on EVERY round across ~2.5h of retries — 8 sign-review invocations (24 fence attempts) plus the review's own inline sign all lost to mechanism A (before != after whole-tracker HEAD moves; retry log SHAs distinct each attempt). A spaced retry loop (45s between rounds) finally persisted the signature on round 6 (19:58 local). Consistent with the ~25%-per-round live failure rate recorded here; under busy-store periods the effective rate was 0% for over two hours.
